svg.text: AURA BY ELECTRO DUDE · Dude Tronix · ESP32-WROOM-32 DevKit V1 + ILI9341/XPT2046 + KY-040 (power: see aura_power_path)
⚠ AURA — prototype / module wiring for presentation (not production PCB)
18650 → TP4056 B+/B− · USB charger → TP4056 IN only
TP4056 OUT+ → slide switch → DevKit VIN · OUT− → GND
OUT ≈ 3.0–4.2 V, no load-sharing, never both USBs at once
1. One shared VSPI bus: TFT + XPT2046 on SCK 18 / MISO 19 / MOSI 23; selected by CS 5 vs CS 21.
2. TFT SPI 40 MHz on IO_MUX pins (fallback 26.67 MHz): keep wires short (<10 cm), common GND.
3. Touch SPI 2 MHz. T_IRQ → GPIO22 UNVERIFIED on module; FW polls ~20 Hz if IRQ never fires.
4. KY-040: module pull-ups on CLK/DT; SW often none → INPUT_PULLUP or 10k to 3V3. SW active-low.
5. TFT VCC and KY-040 '+' from 3V3 (logic level). Backlight LED pin = PWM on GPIO15.
6. GPIO2 / GPIO15 are boot-strapping pins; GPIO34 is input-only (ADC1_CH6).
7. Spare: GPIO16/17. Reserved for I2S (unused in P0): GPIO14/26/27/35.
• Same net label = same electrical net (labels on every wire).
• ALL grounds common: DevKit GND, TFT/touch, encoder, TP4056 OUT−.
• Logic modules (TFT/touch, KY-040) on 3V3 only. DevKit fed via VIN.
• SPI = VSPI IO_MUX pins 18/19/23; TFT clock 40 MHz → keep wires short.
• KY-040 module has CLK/DT pull-ups; bare encoder: add 10k to 3V3 on CLK/DT/SW.
• Net labels = FW macro names (PIN_*) from config.h; GPIO no. on DevKit.
• LED pin driven by GPIO15 PWM; if module has no BL transistor, add one.
• Pins verified vs AURA_v3/config.h (FW source of truth).
AURA I/O connection — DevKit V1 + ILI9341/XPT2046 + KY-040
